app.title: OpenAI CLI
app.author: armcat
app.description: Command‑line interface for interacting with OpenAI APIs, including completions, embeddings, chat, fine‑tuning, and model management.
proposed_tests: Install the CLI from source using go install or download a pre‑built binary.
Run `openai --help` and verify the help output lists all commands.
List available models with `openai models list` and confirm the output is JSON.
Create a completion request with a short prompt and measure response latency.
Check that the CLI can authenticate using an API key set via OPENAI_API_KEY environment variable.
